summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that the presentation of a belt to Tom Allen at the Theatre Comique was postponed a second time, owing to a caved-in sewer, poor lighting and Coburn's absence, until after his fight with Mace.

metadata.notes: masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, May 5, 1870'; page/column not determined

facts.fact: The belt presentation to Allen at the Theatre Comique, St. Louis, was postponed a second time on May 4, 1870; Coburn, who was to spar with him, was out of town, and the presentation was put off until after the Mace fight
Allen's fight with Jem Mace was set for May 10, 1870

notes: Contradicts existing fact 021 (belt presented April 29, 1870). Coburn's first name is not printed; assumed Joe Coburn.
